subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper become the sole protected-environment production deployment authority for crawl-remote under this forward-only D1 recovery model?
rationale: Source review supports the implementation mechanics, but production credential ownership, cross-repository mutation authority, and acceptance of non-reversible database migrations are operational trust decisions that automation cannot make.

options.title: Approve staged cutover
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/37 first, land this workflow with authority unset, provision unique protected credentials, and rehearse dormant rollout and rollback before activation.

options.title: Retain service-owned authority
options.body: Keep production deployment and credentials within crawl-remote and do not activate this centralized workflow.

options.title: Require stronger recovery
options.body: Pause the cutover until operators approve a different migration or database recovery strategy.

recommendation.title: Approve staged cutover
recommendation.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/37 first, land this workflow with authority unset, provision unique protected credentials, and rehearse dormant rollout and rollback before activation.

likelyOwner.reason: His dominant workflow and test history makes him the strongest available owner for the repository-level production trust decision.
